
```{r}
mapping <- mapping[,c(1,2)]

maps <- full_join(new_mapping, mapping, by=join_by(ORI==ori))

maps %>%
  mutate(
    county_std  = tolower(trimws(county)),
    COUNTY_std  = tolower(trimws(COUNTY))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    county_std != COUNTY_std |
    is.na(county_std) != is.na(COUNTY_std)
  )

```

